summary: Retire the new CLI legacy event-feed fallback while preserving server routes for older CLIs

compatibility.detail: The server wire is unchanged in this client-only PR: GET /v1/events, its health feature and GET /v1/events/page remain available. A new following CLI refuses an older daemon without the bounded route instead of entering the legacy feed after an endpoint version transition. Nathan accepted rolling edge as the upgrade target with a two-day transition: this PR must not queue before 2026-10-16 13:50 UTC, two days after the replacement reached edge on 2026-10-14 at about 13:50 UTC. Server-route retirement is a separate dated follow-up requiring its own PR and compatibility decision; no API removal is included here.

manual.detail: From 2026-10-16 13:50 UTC, new CLI follow commands require bounded event continuation. If a daemon just restarted, first rerun the original command. If the route is still missing, install rolling edge on the daemon host with curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/compoundingtech/smalltalk/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --edge --no-run; restart a managed daemon with st service restart, then rerun the original command. No stable release number or source-only commit is the upgrade target. No install, daemon restart or fleet roll is performed by this PR.
